description: This file implements a web service class for SuiteCRM, extending base functionality to support operations such as retrieving, updating, and searching CRM data through SOAP API calls. It includes method definitions for login, retrieving entity details, list queries, module layout, and search functionalities, with access control and session management mechanisms.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImplv3_1
classes.description: Implementation of SOAP web services for SuiteCRM version 3.1, extending core functionality to handle data retrieval, updates, search, and layout metadata, including session management and access control.

methods.name: get_entry
methods.description: Retrieve a single CRM entity (SugarBean) by ID, utilizing get_entries internally.

methods.name: get_module_fields_md5
methods.description: Returns the MD5 hash of the vardef entries for a specific module, useful for cache validation.

methods.name: get_module_layout_md5
methods.description: Fetches the MD5 hash of layout metadata for a module and view type.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Retrieve multiple records (SugarBeans) by their IDs, including link fields if specified.

methods.name: set_entry
methods.description: Create or update a single SugarBean based on provided field values.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticate a user and initialize a session, returning session ID and user info.

methods.name: get_available_modules
methods.description: Return modules accessible to the current user/session, filtered by visibility.

methods.name: get_language_definition
methods.description: Retrieve language strings or their MD5 hashes for specified modules.

methods.name: get_module_layout
methods.description: Fetch layout metadata for modules, with optional MD5 hashing for caching.

methods.name: get_entry_list
methods.description: Retrieve a paginated list of entity records matching query parameters.

methods.name: search_by_module
methods.description: Search across specified modules with a search string, returning matched entities.

methods.name: validateFields
methods.description: Validate provided field data for a module before saving.

methods.name: isIdField
methods.description: Check if a field defined for a bean is of type ID.

methods.name: validateId
methods.description: Validate if a value conforms to the expected ID pattern for a field.
